name: Application shell and navigation
purpose: Owns the persistent frame around every route: top navigation, optional side navigation, skip-link, landmark structure, and the outlet the router renders into.
responsibilities: Render top navigation and, where the project declares secondary structure, side navigation, with active-state semantics per application-spa-REQ-002.
Expose ARIA landmarks (banner, navigation, main, contentinfo) and the skip-link as the first focusable element.
Own keyboard behaviour for shell-level interaction: Tab traversal, arrow-key movement within menus, Escape closing overlays.
Host the global surfaces that outlive routes: network-state banner (application-spa-REQ-014), toast region, and theme toggle.
Apply safe-area insets so shell chrome clears hardware cutouts (application-spa-REQ-003).
internalStructure: A shell layout component wrapping the router outlet; navigation data is declarative (the route inventory from application-spa-REQ-001), not hand-wired per link.

interfaces.name: route inventory
interfaces.description: Declared route table consumed to render navigation and breadcrumbs.

interfaces.name: toast region
interfaces.description: Imperative enqueue API for transient notifications, rendered in one landmark-safe region.

dependencies.name: Theme system
dependencies.description: Shell chrome consumes semantic tokens only.

tradeoffs: A single persistent shell trades a little initial bundle weight for consistent navigation, one focus-management seam, and one place to verify landmarks.
